description: This file defines quantized functional operations for PyTorch, including pooling, convolution, activation functions, and upsampling, specifically for quantized tensors in the torch.ao.nn module.

methods.name: avg_pool2d
methods.description: Applies 2D average pooling on a quantized tensor with specified parameters.

methods.name: avg_pool3d
methods.description: Applies 3D average pooling on a quantized tensor with specified parameters.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d
methods.description: Performs adaptive 2D average pooling on a quantized tensor.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool3d
methods.description: Performs adaptive 3D average pooling on a quantized tensor.

methods.name: conv1d
methods.description: Performs a 1D convolution on a quantized tensor with specified weights and bias.

methods.name: conv2d
methods.description: Performs a 2D convolution on a quantized tensor with specified weights and bias.

methods.name: conv3d
methods.description: Performs a 3D convolution on a quantized tensor with specified weights and bias.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Upsamples or downsamples a quantized tensor to a specified size or scale factor.

methods.name: linear
methods.description: Applies a linear transformation to a quantized tensor.

methods.name: max_pool1d
methods.description: Performs 1D max pooling on a quantized tensor.

methods.name: max_pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D max pooling on a quantized tensor.

methods.name: celu
methods.description: Applies the quantized CELU activation function.

methods.name: leaky_relu
methods.description: Applies the quantized LeakyReLU activation function.

methods.name: hardtanh
methods.description: Applies the quantized HardTanh activation function.

methods.name: hardswish
methods.description: Applies the quantized Hardswish activation function.

methods.name: threshold
methods.description: Applies the quantized threshold function.

methods.name: elu
methods.description: Applies the quantized ELU activation function.

methods.name: hardsigmoid
methods.description: Applies the quantized Hardsigmoid activation function.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps the values of a quantized tensor within a specified range.

methods.name: upsample
methods.description: Upsamples a quantized tensor (deprecated, use interpolate).

methods.name: upsample_bilinear
methods.description: Upsamples a quantized tensor using bilinear mode (deprecated, use interpolate).

methods.name: upsample_nearest
methods.description: Upsamples a quantized tensor using nearest mode (deprecated, use interpolate).
